description: rw.mcp-mesh's shape, MCP identity recorded (U23.2, O8): a front desk imports a billing server's tools with mcp.Server("billing"), mcp.Transport("memory") and mcp.Prefix("svc_") beside a local tool (and, from a second session to the billing service closed before the run, svc_archive_statement), one step calling all five. The tools record names each imported tool's source mcp:billing with its source_detail (server, transport, prefix, remote_name) and the tool the listing skipped (a non-object schema root) once in skipped[] with its reason; each imported call's execute_tool span carries weft.tool.origin mcp:billing — the local call none. svc_get_invoice answers; svc_legacy_ledger's server answers isError (error.type mcp_tool_error); svc_export_statement's handler fails and the server answers a JSON-RPC error (error.type mcp_rpc_error, U23.2-fix); svc_archive_statement's closed session never answers (error.type mcp_transport): three tool errors told apart, problems tool_errors 3; weft.tool.origin stays out of meta
